column1: I absolutely loved this movie! The cast was amazing.
The acting was brilliant, but the story was boring and too long.
It is a lovely film with lovely performances.
Terrible waste of time and money, I hated every minute of it!
The movie runs for two hours and has a standard plot.
Great cinematography and music, though the ending felt rushed.
Not bad at all, actually quite enjoyable.
A boring, predictable mess with weak dialogue.
